description: Finds the Google Business Profile categories that the top-ranking competitors use, how often, and which of them the business lacks. Use it to choose a primary category and secondary categories. Give business, query or both: with only a business, its primary category is the search. The top 8 competitors' profiles are opened one at a time in a background tab for their secondary categories, so it takes about a minute. It works in the user's own Chrome through the Local SEO extension, opening Google Maps in a background tab, and fails with a message saying how to connect when the extension is not connected. Nothing is written to Google. The category counts are read from Maps for free; searchVolumes adds paid DataForSEO search volumes for each category name (one keyword task, about $0.012 plus $0.00012 per category). With source dataforseo it spends from the user's own DataForSEO account inside the extension, within the monthly cap set there; a call over the cap, or with no cap set, is refused with an error saying so, and the same request within the cache window the user set in the extension (7 days unless changed) is served from the cache for nothing. spend says what was charged (null when nothing paid was called). The agent never sees the key. Returns query, competitorsRead, categories (category, usedBy, asPrimary, share 0-1), missing (null when no business was given), volumes (category, monthlySearches or null when unknown, in the business's country, or the United States when its address names no country or no business was given; volumes itself is null unless searchVolumes was asked for and a key is set) and spend.

mapsUrl.description: A Google Maps link to the place, such as https://maps.app.goo.gl/... .

placeId.description: A Google place id, such as "ChIJ...".

cid.description: A Google customer id (CID), decimal digits, as in maps.google.com/?cid=.

city.description: The town or city it is in, such as "Leeds, UK".

name.description: The business name as Google shows it.

business.description: The business to find categories for: {mapsUrl}, {placeId}, {cid} or {name, city}. Its primary category is the search when query is not given, and missing lists what it lacks. Give business, query, or both.

near.description: Where the search is seen from: {lat, lng}, or a place name such as "West Nyack, NY" that is looked up in Maps. Defaults to Maps' own view, which is usually the user's location.

query.description: The search whose top results are read, such as "plumber". Defaults to the business's primary category.

searchVolumes.description: Add monthly search volumes for each category name, a paid DataForSEO call. Defaults to false; the category counts themselves are free.
